summary: STATE_COLOR.canon='#00e5ff' (=--cy) and TYPE_COLOR.memory='#00e5ff' (=--cy) are identical. For nodes m1 and m2 (type=memory, state=canon), both the si-dot (TYPE channel) and si-state label (STATE channel) render --cy (#00e5ff). The viewer cannot distinguish 'this node stores memory' (TYPE) from 'this node is in canon state' (STATE). Source Atlas explicitly establishes memory=blue-voxel/cyan as canonical environment color, making TYPE.memory=--cy CORRECT and FIXED. Therefore, STATE_COLOR.canon=--cy is the dual-use violation. Root cause identified: STATE.canon has no governance color anchor — it uses --cy by default rather than the 🟡 SEALED (gold/amber) governance semantic it represents.
